description: Press keys in a desktop capsule, in order. Each entry is one key or a '+'-joined chord (xdotool names): ['ctrl+c'] copies, ['ctrl+l', 'Return'] focuses then submits, ['alt+F4'] closes a window. A bare modifier followed by a key is joined into a chord, so ['ctrl','v'] also pastes.

screenshot.description: Capture a screenshot after the action and return it

screenshotDelayMs.description: Settle delay (ms) before that screenshot so it reflects the result (max 10000)

title: Press keys
